label: 🔄 Cast type
description: Change the data type of a column. Failed casts become NULL by default.

targetType.label: Target type
targetType.help: Index: integer column where every value should be unique (duplicates are flagged in the grid). Timezone: string column constrained to IANA zone names like America/New_York (invalid entries flagged in red).

strict.label: Strict (fail on bad values)
strict.help: Off: failed casts become NULL. On: pipeline fails on first bad value.
